intro: 1 handful of almonds (30 g) has about 170 kcal. Most of the calories come from fat, mainly unsaturated fat.
diet: Yes, almonds are a good snack because they have healthy fat, fibre and some protein. But they're calorie-dense. Eating straight from the jar, you can easily finish 300-500 kcal without noticing. The key is portion.
tips: Pack almonds into small 30 g containers for the week and bring them to the office.
Choose almonds without salt or coating.
Pair with fruit like an apple for a more filling snack.

swap.name: Almonds 15 g + 1 apple
swap.why: Same calories but more food, extra fibre and a fresh sweet taste.

faq.q: How many almonds are in 30 g?
Raw or roasted almonds, which is better?
faq.a: Both are okay. Choose roasted ones without too much oil and salt.

faq.q: Are almonds okay as a night snack?
faq.a: Can, as long as you stick to the portion. A small handful is enough to ease hunger.
